items.t: In Maillardville, Coquitlam, townhomes sold at a median of $763,000 across 17 sales, and the middle half closed between $615,000 and $1,098,000. The median townhome sat 25 days and sold for 97.2% of list.
Maillardville, Coquitlam: 15 condos sold at a median of $528,000, with the middle half between $410,000 and $596,000. The median condo took 21 days to sell and closed at 99.3% of list.

21 duplexes sold in Maillardville, Coquitlam at a median of $1,285,000 (middle half $1,167,000 to $1,350,000). A typical duplex in Maillardville, Coquitlam spent 13 days on the market and closed at 97.4% of the asking price.

blocks.text: Source: Paragon closed sales, November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026; medians need 5 or more sales.
How Maillardville compares with the rest of Coquitlam

items.t: Townhomes in Maillardville have the 9th highest median of 11 Coquitlam sub-areas, $763,000. Central Coquitlam is lowest at $617,500 and Westwood Plateau highest at $1,132,500. Ranch Park ($622,500) sits just below and Coquitlam East ($802,250) sits just above.

Of 8 Coquitlam sub-areas with 5 or more condo sales, Maillardville ranks 6th highest at $528,000; the range is $426,250 (Central Coquitlam) to $695,000 (New Horizons). Coquitlam East ($515,000) sits just below and Canyon Springs ($530,000) sits just above.
Duplexes in Maillardville have the highest median of the 3 Coquitlam sub-areas, $1,285,000, ahead of Coquitlam West at $1,275,000; the lowest is Central Coquitlam at $1,150,000.
